source_citation: Bower, Serra and Ambar (2002), Structure of the Mediterranean Undercurrent and Mediterranean Water spreading around the southwestern Iberian Peninsula, JGR Oceans 107(C10), doi:10.1029/2001JC001007.
layer: Nonmeddy lower-core Mediterranean Water context, 950–1250 dbar observational selection. Pressure bounds are not converted to uniform depth; vertically separated cores and upstream bottom-trapped density flow remain distinct.
sampling_context: AMUSE floats deployed May 1993–March 1994 and tracked for up to 11 months, with May 1993 hydrography and augmented Iberian observations. Selected path is editorial geography, not one dated float trajectory, annual mean or seasonal axis.
width_scope: 30 km core-to-offshore zero crossing and 10 km geostrophic survey band have different boundaries and support; not a seasonal pair.

additional_width_evidence_pending_defini.feature: Mean northward-flow band in western slope Region 2, 0.04–0.06 m/s; source says at least 50 km, not a paired-edge whole-current width.

excluded_inferences: No upstream gravity-current route silently joined to lower core.
No salt-tongue geometry equated with current axis.
No meddy float loops counted in boundary-current length.
No float launch window treated as observation end dates.
remaining_gates: Review launch neighborhood, cape detour and 38.2 N longitude against finer bathymetry and observational support.
Diagnose a depth/time-compatible current axis before physical length or seasonal bounds.
Resolve western-slope branch loss and farther-north continuity before whole-current endpoints.
Keep 30 km one-sided ensemble span and 10 km survey band separate; no seasonal 10–30 km width range or buffered footprint.
